statement:
∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ),
  0 < R →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (closedBall c R) →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ g (closedBall c R) → (∀ z ∈ sphere c R, f z = g z) → iteratedDeriv n f c = iteratedDeriv n g c

universal.type: ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, f z = g z
universal.name: hfg

hyps.text: ∀ z ∈ sphere c R, f z = g z
hyps.name: hfg

goal.text: iteratedDeriv n f c = iteratedDeriv n g c

values: (fun u : ℂ => 2 * Complex.sin u * Complex.cos u)
